title: Morning Brief — Monday, 2 November 2026
description: Education ministers weigh a return to pen-and-paper NAPLAN writing tests, Queensland braces for severe storms in the south-east and a heatwave in the Gulf Country, and the Gold Coast Suns plan to redraft two delisted forwards. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
